title: drymocallis glandulosa subsp. reflexa
intro: Drymocallis glandulosa subsp. reflexa, commonly known as western sweetroot or yampah, is a perennial herb native to North America, characterized by its yellow flowers and edible roots. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and alleviating pain. The therapeutic actions of western sweetroot include antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its healing effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glycosides, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
